name: @csszyx/vscode
description: IntelliSense, hover docs, and diagnostics for CSSzyx sz props

markdownEnumDescriptions: **Recommended.** The bundled `@csszyx/ts-plugin` provides `sz`/`szv`/`szs` completions in TypeScript/JavaScript, a trigger companion opens the list on `{`, `,`, `:` and space, and the extension covers HTML. No duplicate suggestions.
Disable the plugin and let the extension provide completions in every language (a fallback if you prefer the extension's provider).
Never provide `sz` completions. Hover and diagnostics are unaffected.
csszyx.completions.markdownDescription: Who provides `sz`/`szv`/`szs` completions. In `auto`, the bundled `@csszyx/ts-plugin` handles TypeScript/JavaScript and the extension handles HTML, so you never see duplicate suggestions.

csszyx.enableDiagnostics.description: Report unknown sz props as warnings.

csszyx.enableHover.description: Show generated Tailwind classes on hover.

scripts.vsix: pnpm --filter @csszyx/tooling-metadata --filter @csszyx/ts-plugin build && pnpm build && node scripts/package.mjs
scripts.vsix:publish: pnpm --filter @csszyx/tooling-metadata --filter @csszyx/ts-plugin build && pnpm build && node scripts/package.mjs --publish
